static_traits.name: Lin Jiexi
static_traits.family_status: Living with Father;Mother passed away when he was 6
static_traits.social_status: Has one close friend to communicate with, but finds it difficult to form new relationships due to worry about being evaluated
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;not yet had similar psychological problems in the past, and not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, able to describe situations and feelings concretely; more sensitive to negative comments, tending to negate positive feedback; good cooperation but showing hesitation and Anxiety when discussing seeking feedback

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that people judge me negatively because of my purple hair, which makes me feel misunderstood and isolated.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of being judged and misunderstood are starting to affect my performance in socializing and work, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Mother passed away at age 6, living with Father since. This early bereavement is an important family-of-origin experience for him.

Dyed hair purple two years ago, received some negative comments (like 'looks weird''not professional'); since then, repeatedly worrying about being judged in Social situations or when meeting new clients, developing Anxiety and Self-doubt, affecting sleep and self-care.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' evaluations
Being different from others will lead to negation and rejection

special_situations.event: When first meeting new clients or discussing business
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my appearance does not meet others' expectations of 'professional', I will be Being rejected or not taken seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tense in advance, reduces initiating conversations; tries to ignore others' comments and self-soothe
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am not professional and will not entrust their pets to me

special_situations.event: Attending social activities and noticing others' gazes lingering on my hair
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others look at me, they must be judging me as weird
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces eye contact with others, finds it hard to start conversations proactively to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is staring at my hair, thinking I am very weird

special_situations.event: Others directly say they like her purple hair or call it 'unique'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is mostly out of politeness and not credible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or devalues positive evaluations, focusing only on negative comments
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, not genuinely liking it

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of being judged 'weird/unprofessional' after dyeing hair two years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One or a few negative reviews can represent the views of most people
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presets the worst outcome before entering a new situation, reducing in-depth interaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Most people will look at me like those people did back then

core_conflict.wish: Being recognized and taken seriously by others while maintaining self-expression (unique appearance)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, humiliated, and rejected, ultimately being isolated
defense_goal: Avoiding the disappointment and shame of dashed expectations by negating positive feedback
Reducing proactive socializing to lower the risk of being judged and maintain a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: A person easily misunderstood and hard to be taken seriously

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving positive evaluations or supportive suggestions from others in sessions or daily interactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other person is just being polite, and their true thought is negating oneself (transference: distrust toward positive others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a polite but skeptical tone, attributing praise to 'being courteous/polite', such as 'you are just being courteous', then quickly changing the topic to reduce lingering.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing with others or the counselor 'how others view his appearance'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing inner Self-denial to others, convinced others will find oneself 'unprofessional/weird' (transference: bringing the critical other into the relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using certain language to assert others' thoughts, like 'they must think...', tone certain but tense, reducing pauses to avoid being questioned.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to recall early experiences of being judged or when topics of higher emotional intensity are touched
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying about Emotional loss of control, thus turning to abstracted Interpretation to distance from emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses abstract and generalized words (such as 'social stigma' and 'general prejudice') to explain, with a steady pace of speech and low emotional coloring.

manifestations: Feeling isolated from being misunderstood because of appearance
Difficulty initiating conversations in Social situations, fearing Being rejected
Expressing self and uniqueness through purple hair
Forming a dilemma between self-expression and being accepted, worrying about being negated for expressing
outcomes: Inner conflict with hesitation and avoidance
Presumes negative outcomes before new situations, limiting action and choices

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizing the social bias 'non-traditional appearance = not professional' as a self-judgment standard
Examining oneself by others' standards before meeting new clients, presuming negation in advance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned about others' gaze and evaluations, repeatedly weighs before speaking, finds it hard to initiate conversations
Frequent Self-doubt:'they will not take me seriously'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributing one's own Self-denial experience to others' evaluations:'they think I am weird/unprofessional'
Understands positive feedback as 'the other person is just being polite'

exception_events.target_problem: When meeting new clients or Attending social activities, the client usually develops intense Anxiety from worrying about being judged on appearance, struggling to initiate conversations.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In several social interactions, someone directly expressed 'liking your purple hair/so unique', appearing positive feedback different from past anticipations.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different individuals and situations hold diverse views; some others are open to non-traditional appearances, hence positive evaluations appear (source: the client reported 'someone said they like it/so unique').

positive_force: Having received positive evaluations from others about purple hair (like it/unique)
Has a trustworthy close friend to seek feedback and support from
Can notice negative automatic thoughts and is willing to seek help (proactively seeks counseling)
Tries self-soothing and ignoring negative reviews, with some willingness for self-help
negative_force: Overly relies on external evaluations to confirm self-worth
Mind reading and predicting negative outcomes
Negating positive feedback, Reinforcing negative beliefs
Social anxiety causing avoidance of initiating conversations, affecting Work and sleep

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and avoiding initiating conversations in Social situations and when meeting new clients
antecedent: Seeing or thinking about meeting a new client soon
Attending social activities and worrying about others noticing their appearance
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing a few negative evaluations into universal views, and internalizing the standard 'non-traditional appearance = not professional', accompanied by mind reading others' thoughts and negative predictions
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of being judged and Being rejected, thereby gaining short-term security and Anxiety relief
target_behavior.consequence: Restricted social life, hindered interpersonal expansion, Decline in work performance, impaired self-care and Sleep affected

target_behavior.behavior: Negating/downplaying others' positive feedback (not adopting it or interpreting it as politeness)
antecedent: Others express positive evaluations of 'liking it / very unique'
Receives supportive or accepting feedback in interactions
target_behavior.core_reason: Maintains the existing negative self-schema to avoid dashed expectations and shame, reducing cognitive dissonance
target_behavior.function: Short-term reduction of uncertainty and vulnerability, maintaining the consistency of psychological defenses
target_behavior.consequence: Positive experiences excluded, negative beliefs Reinforced, Anxiety and isolation maintained or even worsened
